title: blob-types: Blob/convert recipes and Blob/lookup types
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B3. Crates: jmap-blob-types. Size: M.

Implement docs/design/blobext.md §4 (second half) in crate-jmap-blob-types: convert.rs (ConvertRequest with exactly-one-recipe custom Deserialize, Recipe and the seven recipe structs, ColorSpace, ArchiveEntry, EntryType, CompressionMethod, ConvertedBlob, BlobConvertResponse, compress_level_range per §8.5.1-4), lookup.rs (BlobLookupArgs, BlobInfo, BlobLookupResponse with no notFound). No data_types module here: the registry is jmap_types::data_types (B1, decision 14). Specs: blobext-03 §6, §8-§8.8, §9.3-§9.7. Acceptance: §9.3-§9.7 request/response round-trips from hand-written JSON; every Other variant round-trips; Recipe with 0/1/2 recipe keys; ArchiveEntry wire names (blockDevice, charDevice, linkTarget); public-api snapshot.
